explanation: The extract_hospital_db function queries TBL_VISIT joined with LKP_VISIT_TYPE to pull encounter records and decode service type labels. It validates patient references, timestamps, and visit numbers, reformatting dates to ISO 8601 and setting status dynamically based on completion timestamps. Failed validation checks log sanitized messages specifying row numbers and rejected field names without revealing sensitive patient data.
suggested_tests: Test valid completed visit row correctly produces Encounter resource with 'finished' status, ISO timestamps, and formatted serviceType.
Test in-progress visit with null VISIT_END produces Encounter with 'in-progress' status and no period.end field.
Test invalid patient reference containing special characters or invalid datetime string logs a rejected message with field name and skips output.
